sql: WITH FamilyOpenListings AS (SELECT family, COUNT(posting_key) AS open_listings FROM fct_posting WHERE is_open = TRUE AND remote_us = TRUE AND is_canonical_listing = TRUE GROUP BY family), TotalOpenListings AS (SELECT COUNT(posting_key) AS total_listings FROM fct_posting WHERE is_open = TRUE AND remote_us = TRUE AND is_canonical_listing = TRUE) SELECT fol.family, fol.open_listings, CAST(fol.open_listings AS DOUBLE) / tol.total_listings AS share_of_total FROM FamilyOpenListings fol, TotalOpenListings tol ORDER BY fol.open_listings DESC
